lines.story-0: Welcome to the Earth Jukebox. Every sound you'll hear is played by a NASA Earth Information Center map.
lines.story-1: The ocean plays the cello. Warm water sings high, and cold water sings low. Here is the Gulf Stream, carrying the tropics north.
lines.story-2: Rain is a flute, and clouds are a soft pad. Listen to the rain over India.
lines.story-3: Lightning is a violin. Watch the needle sweep across the map. Every flash it crosses becomes a note.
lines.story-4: Now, humanity. City lights play a clarinet, deliberately out of key with the planet.
lines.story-5: Carbon emissions are a low, heavy drone. Traffic and industry are an oboe.
lines.story-6: Here at home, in the Gulf, everything plays at once.
lines.story-7: Now, let's mute humanity, and listen to the planet without us.
lines.story-8: This is the Earth, in tune. Use the humanity lever to bring us back. Now it's your turn. Pick a record, zoom anywhere, and listen.
lines.mode-listen: Listen. You hear everything on the screen. Zoom in to hear one place.
lines.mode-scan: Scan. A needle sweeps across the map. Higher on the screen is a higher note.
lines.mode-probe: Probe. Point anywhere, and hear just that spot.
lines.mute: Humanity muted. This is the planet without us.
